authority.binding: A non-empty iLink bot_token persisted as a 0600 JSON file under ~/Library/Application Support/com.tocode.app/wechat-credential.json after a confirmed QR response from a trusted HTTPS weixin.qq.com host.
authority.receive_time: Local wall-clock time and current system timezone captured when each message is accepted from getupdates.
authority.cursor: Application Support state advanced only after all previously unprocessed messages in the response are archived successfully.

invariants: Ordinary (non-command, non-quick-input) messages are receive-only: the runtime must never call sendmessage or any other outbound WeChat message API for them.

The only outbound WeChat message API exceptions are a '.'-prefixed command reply and a recognized quick-input reply; each is sent once to the originating conversation and is not treated as an archived inbound message.
Bearer tokens are sent only over HTTPS to weixin.qq.com or a subdomain and never appear in browser files, notifications, logs, archives, or persisted cursor state.
Transient transport errors and HTTP 5xx preserve the current binding; only HTTP 401 or 403 remove the credential.
A rebind does not disturb the old listener until the new confirmed credential is safely stored.
Archive files are append-only and attachments never overwrite an existing path.
context_token, request headers, bearer tokens, and AES keys are not written to Markdown.
prohibited_results: Reading unrelated personal WeChat conversations or historical messages.
Sending acknowledgements, AI replies, or any other WeChat message for ordinary (non-command, non-quick-input) messages.
Archiving a '.'-prefixed command message or a recognized quick-input message to wechat*.md or saving its attachments.
Treating a mock integration test as successful real-account runtime E2E.
Advancing the cursor or dedupe state after an archive write failure.
Creating a fabricated voice file when iLink provides ASR text only.
